en.title: Minimum Fruits Left After Removing Pairs of Different Kinds
en.description:
Each time, remove two fruits of different kinds; you may choose any positions and repeat this any number of times. Find the minimum number of fruits left at the end.

Standard input/output, examples and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's do not claim to be the source's original limits.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n kind IDs (1..10⁹).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: remove one 3 together with a 1, then the other 3 with another 1, leaving the 2, so 1 fruit remains. Example 2: the only 2 can remove just one 1, leaving two 1s. Example 3: the two kinds are removed together directly, leaving 0.
hints: Let f be the maximum frequency. The answer is max(2f−n,n mod 2).
